end.summary:
Practised ordering levels: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Discussed how cells work together to form tissues and how tissues form organs.
Identified muscle tissue, cardiac muscle, heart as an organ, and circulatory system as an organ system.
Discussed amoeba as a single-celled organism and named stomach, intestine, and liver as digestive-system organs.
Teach-back was not passed; order was correct unaided once in four attempts.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation and used football-team examples to discuss how parts at one level depend on each other. Yash correctly connected cells with tissues, tissues with organs, and identified the heart as an organ; they also named several digestive organs. There was a mix-up about whether the circulatory system contains only the heart, and this was not clearly corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, Yash can draw the five-level ladder and add two or three organs in the circulatory or digestive system.
